decisions.reason: As a large incumbent with some slack, we would keep this still-listed naval lighting line because its continued presence suggests performance at least near aspiration in a specialist segment that fits our robust, standards-driven portfolio.

We would keep this interior luminaire for now, but its more generic application and reduced prominence versus launch make it the most exposed if results drift below aspiration and resources are needed elsewhere.

We would keep this pendant luminaire because management highlighted it as a flagship tied to the firm’s strategic direction, so current evidence points to satisfactory performance and strong internal commitment.

We would keep this marine searchlight line because it remains on the market in a specialist niche aligned with our application-specific strengths, and a large firm can tolerate some uncertainty while results are still acceptable.
